Published numeric intake: 70
fields.Fees — Published:
₹9.25 lakh MBA course fee: year 1 ₹4.875 lakh + year 2 ₹4.375 lakh, per current official programme page.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 9.25
fields.Fee Scope: Published two-year course schedule; hostel and transport separate; refundable/non-tuition component treatment should be checked before payment.
fields.Accepted Exams: MBA-specific page: MAT or GD Goenka Aptitude Test. General admissions FAQ says no university entrance test; obtain confirmation of the applicable 2026 route.
fields.Eligibility: Graduation from a recognised institution with at least 50%; Class XII or equivalent from a recognised board, any stream.
fields.Selection Process: MBA-specific page: qualifying examination marks and MAT or GD Goenka Aptitude Test, followed by personal interview, shortlist and offer. General FAQ contradicts the own-test route; current programme instructions require admissions confirmation.
